description: This file defines a subclass of Android's JobService, named JobWorkService, which manages background work enqueued via JobScheduler. It includes nested classes for processing work asynchronously (CommandProcessor), and methods for handling lifecycle events of the service, showing notifications, and managing job execution.

classes.name: JobWorkService
classes.description: A JobService subclass that processes enqueued work items asynchronously, managing notifications and job lifecycle events.

classes.name: CommandProcessor
classes.description: An AsyncTask inner class that dequeues and processes work items in background, handling notification display and job completion.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the notification manager and shows a toast indicating service creation.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Hides notifications and shows a toast indicating service destruction.

methods.name: onStartJob
methods.description: Starts the CommandProcessor to handle work asynchronously and allows the job to keep running.

methods.name: onStopJob
methods.description: Cancels the current command processing and requests rescheduling of the job.

methods.name: showNotification
methods.description: Builds and displays a persistent notification indicating ongoing work in the service.
